app.title: Cell Explorer: zoom, enhance and describe one microscopy image at a time
app.summary: The person uploads a set of JPG images and picks one from a numbered list. They choose a point with X and Y sliders and a zoom level to crop in on a region, then adjust contrast, brightness and sharpness while the processed image redraws. They type a free-text description of what they see. Then they save the processed image, a JSON record of the crop and enhancement settings, and the description as files, and can rename all three with one shared random suffix so the set stays together.

task.text: Close in on a region of interest in a microscopy image, make its features easier to see, and keep the processed image, the settings that produced it and a written description so the view can be reproduced.

data.text: A set of uploaded JPG images, each resized to a fixed square size, shown one at a time.

stage.text: exploring microscopy images to find and bring out features of interest, before analysis

mechanism.text: A column of controls (image picker, crop position and zoom sliders, enhancement sliders) redraws one large processed image each time a value changes. Below the image, a description box and save buttons write the image, the slider settings and the notes out as files that sit side by side.

field.text: image inspection and enhancement for microscopy in cell biology

workflow.name: inspect one image closely, enhance it and record the view

steps.here: a multi-file uploader takes JPG images; the other controls only appear after a file is uploaded
a select box picks one uploaded image by its index, and it is resized to a fixed square size

steps.step: move to the region of interest and zoom in
steps.here: X and Y sliders set a centre point and a zoom slider sets how far to crop in around it; the crop is scaled back up to full size

steps.step: adjust the display so the features stand out
steps.here: contrast, brightness and sharpness sliders are applied in turn to the cropped image
a 'Describe the image' text area, saved to a text file with 'Save Description'

a 'Save Image' checkbox writes the processed JPG, 'Save Image Parameters' writes the coordinates, zoom and enhancement values as JSON, and 'Rename Files' gives all three files one shared random number suffix

distinctive: the exact crop centre, zoom and enhancement values are saved as JSON next to the image, so the processed view can be made again
the processed image, its parameters and its description are renamed together with one shared suffix, so the three files stay linked
every image is resized to a fixed square before cropping, so coordinates mean the same thing across images

parts.title: Upload and pick an image

parts.title: Contrast, brightness and sharpness

parts.title: Description and saving
parts.summary: The area under the image where the person writes about it and saves the outputs.

parts.title: Describe the image
